observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 35 stand in the left margin and the locator «p. 222.» (L11) in the right margin; in the locator the 2s are printed blotted. The count of the lines runs through the spaces and the head of D: 5 stands beside the first line of the title.
body L1-L3: the head D is set in a larger bold type, the title in a larger type, both centred.
body L5: the stroke of the first fraction after «135» is printed broken, its foot apart like a point.
body L17: the minus sign of «780 — 1/10» is printed as a dash.
body L28: a speck stands over the first + after «115»; it is not a sign.
notes_left L8: the denominator of the fraction is printed blotted, like 8; read as 3, as in the fraction of the text (L16).
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
